codeReview.summary: The feature implements solution (b) as required: `audit/alignment.json` is committed with 1..15 generated-page mappings, `audit/image_diff.py` reads alignment data with positional fallback when the file is absent/malformed, and the design note documents derivation and regeneration steps. Core audit scoring math for mapped pages remains unchanged.

issues.description: Alignment values are joined to `--reference` without basename/path validation (`out[idx] = ref_dir / str(v)`). A malformed mapping like `../build/page-1.png` would be accepted and could compare against non-reference files, weakening audit integrity. Restrict values to bare `page_###.png` names and reject path separators/`..`.
